nbook-agent.name: Agent
nbook-agent.description: Writing assistant sessions and runs; takes the extensions, tools and profiles plugins provide.

nbook-bots.name: Bots
nbook-bots.description: Resident bots: created from presets that plugins provide, each with its own folder and one long-running main conversation.

nbook-canon.name: World engine
nbook-canon.description: The book's setting and story: entries, story changes, checks and the change history, worked out for every point in the book.

nbook-commands.name: Commands
nbook-commands.description: Registers and runs commands; the command palette and keybindings run the commands registered here.

nbook-desktop.name: Desktop
nbook-desktop.description: Window settings of the desktop app: zoom (with its shortcuts and commands), opening NeuroBook when you sign in to Windows, and whether closing the last window quits NeuroBook or keeps it in the system tray. The settings section appears only in desktop app windows.

nbook-editor.name: Editor
nbook-editor.description: Editor tabs and groups; opening and saving documents.

nbook-explorer.name: Explorer
nbook-explorer.description: The file tree of your book in the sidebar.

nbook-files.name: Files
nbook-files.description: Reads and writes files and folders in your book.

nbook-html-preview.name: HTML Preview
nbook-html-preview.description: Previews HTML files in a sandbox.

nbook-http.name: Local Server
nbook-http.description: The local HTTP server for pages and APIs.

nbook-markdown.name: Markdown
nbook-markdown.description: Markdown for your book: reading and writing rules, editor extensions and rendering.

nbook-models.name: Model Service
nbook-models.description: Providers and models, keys and model roles; supplies models to the writing assistant.

nbook-network.name: Network
nbook-network.description: The Network section in settings: automatic model list updates, and later a proxy.

nbook-plot.name: Story
nbook-plot.description: Knowledge, foreshadowing and character goals on top of the world engine: who knows what, and how far each setup has come.

nbook-plugins.name: Plugin Manager
nbook-plugins.description: Installs, enables, disables and uninstalls plugins.

nbook-projects.name: Books
nbook-projects.description: The bookshelf; creating and opening books.

nbook-settings.name: Settings
nbook-settings.description: The settings window and setting values.

nbook-stickers.name: Stickers
nbook-stickers.description: Sticker packs: your own, those from plugins and the built-in ones; stickers in Agent replies are looked up here.

nbook-tasks.name: Background Tasks
nbook-tasks.description: Long-running tasks started by plugins: progress, cancelling and retrying, and a notification when they finish.

nbook-workbench.name: Workbench
nbook-workbench.description: The workbench shell: sidebars, panel, title bar and status bar.

nbook-theme-study.name: Study Theme
nbook-theme-study.description: A look for writing: a window by day, a desk lamp by night.

nbook-web.name: Web Tools
nbook-web.description: Web search and page reading for the writing assistant, through the DeepSeek or Tavily search API.
